title: Timesheet and Payroll Correction
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

inputs/punch_corrections.csv supersedes punch records by record_id. Apply corrections before pairing. Write output/correction_summary.csv with header employee_id,old_gross_pay,corrected_gross_pay,delta for employees whose gross changed; delta is corrected minus old, money uses two decimals, and rows are sorted by employee_id.

inputs/union_rules.json now applies to group U: hours after 8 in a local day pay 1.5x and after 12 pay 2x; weekly overtime does not stack. Keep the night differential additive on base pay. Recalculate all files and retain correction_summary.csv.
